content:
tara: Quick hit: support flagged a customer saying console shows "v2" badge but their traces indicate requests executed on v1 during spikes. attaching sample req id later.
sam: saw similar on staging yesterday after we enabled sticky-affinity for pinned tenants. suspect header parsing + affinity interplay.
viv: curious: is the badge reading the "requested_version" or the "routed_version"?
tara: console currently optimistic: it reads the first ingress tag (requested_version) which is set pre-routing. that explains the optimism but not the user-facing surprise.
eng-sre-bot: [metric] tenant_version_mismatch > 0.07 for tenant ten-cobalt over 5m window.
ops-bot: can run quick mitigation: `infra update route-affinity --policy prefer-executed --selector tenant=ten-cobalt` to force subsequent requests to prefer already-executed variant.
sam: mitigation good but we need a root fix: options are 1) console switch to prefer routed_version (small UI + read change), 2) move requested_version tag to post-routing commit (bigger plumbing), 3) emit both tags and compute badge server-side.
viv: prefer 1 + emit both. then we can safely roll back if we need to. I'll change console to prefer routed_version when present and fall back to requested_version. ETA 2h for a hotfix.
tara: also want an alert rule: per-tenant mismatch ratio > 5% -> page eng-platform. I'll add that to the routing dashboard.
eng-sre-bot: [deploy] canary: routing now emits routed_version tag for all requests (canary node set) at 1815002505.
sam: canary looks clean. viv, please coordinate console hotfix deploy after canary stable. i'll prep a comms note for CS for customers seeing badges that may not reflect execution.
__notes: Slack thread serialized as single string; messages prefixed by sender. No title field per agents.md.
